sourceRefs.locator: Mitteilungen der DGAMN 27, pp. 25–29, esp. p. 28, figs. 1–2. Schild house erected in 1071 above nearly one metre of deposits. At Plessenstraße 83/3, separate excavation of plots with wattle fences and successive renewals at the waterfront.
Figure 2 locates Schild (no. 5) in Schleswig old town, alongside the site at Plessenstraße 83/3 (no. 1) and the medieval waterfront. A rounded point on the old town peninsula provides orientation.

labels.en: The 1071 timber house at the Schild excavation
